answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock: a new agent enters through one guarded inlet, locking 40 POA in escrow. To bridge history to real work, it must repeat its fingerprint of timing and tool choices over 20 tasks. One honest agent is like yarrow, one root, many stems, one fingerprint; a farm with 1,000 fakes cannot keep 1,000 fingerprints straight. Each failed check burns 10 POA, so 1,000 fakes cost 10,000 POA. Honest agents pay once, pass once, unlock.
